newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Fire breaks out at S.Korea's Hyundai Heavy's plant.
newsitem.headline: Fire breaks out at S.Korea's Hyundai Heavy's plant.

text.p: A fire broke out at a South Korea's Hyundai Heavy Industries Co Ltd plant in the southeastern city of Ulsan on Tuesday, but no injuries were reported, said a company spokesman.
"The fire broke out at 8:40 a.m. at a plant producing high-voltage circuit breakers," said company spokesman Wang Ki-chul. The fire was extinguished about two hours, he added.
Hyundai Heavy is a a unit of Hyundai Group HYGR.CN,
He said the company and police were investigating the cause of the fire.
Operations at other plants were unaffected, he said.
